mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST T USING ( SELECT #{groupId} AS STOCK_GROUP, #{stockCode} AS STOCK_CODE, NVL(NULLIF(#{groupDiv,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'normal') AS STOCK_GROUP_DIV, #{stockClose} AS STOCK_CLOSE FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.STOCK_GROUP = S.STOCK_GROUP AND T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE, T.STOCK_CLOSE = NVL(S.STOCK_CLOSE, T.STOCK_CLOSE), T.STOCK_GROUP_DIV = S.STOCK_GROUP_DIV WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_SEQ, STOCK_CODE, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_GROUP_DIV, STOCK_CLOSE, STOCK_30MIN_SMA_LINES, STOCK_SMA_LINES, MODIFY_DATE, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(STOCK_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST), S.STOCK_CODE, S.STOCK_GROUP, S.STOCK_GROUP_DIV, S.STOCK_CLOSE, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST WHERE STOCK_GROUP = #{groupId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ( CASE WHEN STOCK_GROUP_DIV IS NULL OR TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV) = '' THEN 'normal' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) IN ('close', 'undefined') THEN 'normal' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) = 'monthend' THEN 'month' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) END ) = NVL(NULLIF(#{groupDiv,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'normal')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST WHERE STOCK_GROUP = #{groupId} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stockCode} AND ( CASE WHEN STOCK_GROUP_DIV IS NULL OR TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV) = '' THEN 'normal' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) IN ('close', 'undefined') THEN 'normal' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) = 'monthend' THEN 'month' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(STOCK_GROUP_DIV)) END ) = NVL(NULLIF(#{groupDiv,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), 'normal')
